Math/TeX handoff emits MathML semantics annotations carrying escaped source TeX for reviewer and accessibility tooling without invoking MathJax, KaTeX, or TeX engines. PDF review-packet handoff now records expected TeX sidecars, fake-produced artifact hashes, log warnings/errors, and rerun-needed signals so WordPress import queues can triage failed or incomplete PDF exports without running renderers. ODT, CSL/BibTeX, YAML, doctemplate, archive compression, math/TeX, legacy DOC/CFB, charset, XML/HTML5 DOM, and PDF engine handoff paths remain native PHP and external-tool free. EPUB3 package handoff preserves OCF container and OPF metadata, spine order, nav/NCX table-of-contents targets, missing non-spine asset diagnostics, and raw XHTML spine content as WordPress HTML blocks without invoking Pandoc, zip/unzip, or browser renderers.
